text:
rachel: HorizonTech asked for a compact perf/W + throughput comparison between their EdgeX2 board and our reference Ampere pool next Wed. They want a one-slide marketplace card + joint blog blurb. Can we scope?
sam: short scope propose: models distilgpt2, gpt-neo-125M, llama2-7b-trim. seqs: 256 and 1024. bs: 1,2,4. concurrency: 1,4. capture p50/p95/p99 latency and avg watts.
pablo: also collect KV cache hit rates and per-token power samples (100ms). partner wants both "stock-kernel" and "horizon-rt" lines.
emily: product asks for approved logo + partner quote and embargo until coordinated publish. timeline ok?
rachel: dry-run Mon, full sweep Tue-Wed. blockers: NDA addendum for kernel variant, partner power telemetry access, and agreed appendix with prompt seeds.
sam: bench-bot please create template job and include kernel toggle and power sampling params.
ops-bot: created job/horizon-edge-quickbench-2025-01. Config: `models:[distilgpt2,gptneo-125m,llama2-7b-trim] seq:[256,1024] bs:[1,2,4] conc:[1,4] power_csv:/artifacts/horizon/$JOB_ID/power.csv kernel_variants:[stock,horizon-rt] sample_ms:100`.
pablo: perfect. legal needs to review addendum; @legal flagged RED-900.
emily: I'll draft the one-paragraph marketplace blurb and request logo + quote by Tue EOD.
rachel: infra will provision a pre-signed S3 for aggregated charts only. sam, can you produce a 1-page perf card (throughput vs watts) after runs?
sam: yes, will deliver perf-card Tue evening.
pablo: note reproducibility: include dataset tarball sha256 and retokenization hash in appendix.
rachel: thanks all 44d tagging RED-900 for follow-up. bench-bot: scheduled job/horizon-edge-quickbench-2025-01 for 2025-01-14 08:00 UTC. Logs -> /artifacts/horizon-edge-quickbench-2025-01/logs.
